summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 451,250 common shares and 1,111,250 pre-funded warrants at $3.20 per share (warrant price $3.199) to raise up to $5 million. Univest Securities acts as placement agent with a 7% fee. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. There are no strategic or structural events such as acquisitions, spin-offs, or activist campaigns. What to watch: potential dilution and use of proceeds, but no special-situation angle.
